_doc: On-disk byte budget for the release bundle (overnight plan C, wave C-W1 = PLc).
Gate: `bun run test:budget` reads dist/**/*.{js,css}(.br) AFTER a real
`bun run build` (release build, NO VITE_E2E) and asserts every chunk,
every stylesheet and the transfer total against this file. The .br
sibling is what go/web/web.go actually serves (verify lens = release lens).
CALIBRATED 2026-07-05 inside the pinned toolchain container
(e2e/toolchain.lock sha256 8a0d9ebe2614, bun 1.3 / vite 8.0.16 /
vite-plugin-compression2 2.5.3 at brotli DEFAULT quality Q11 —
vite.config.ts sets no explicit quality). Brotli output is
node/toolchain-version-sensitive: budgets and the determinism verdict
hold ONLY for in-container builds. Two consecutive container builds were
byte-identical (sha256 over all js/css/br artifacts) on 2026-07-05.
RUNBOOK: a toolchain.lock digest bump is a RE-BASELINE event — re-measure
inside the new container and update budgets + toolchain_lock_sha256_12 in
the SAME commit, otherwise the gate goes falsely red after the update.
Budget policy: overrides = measured .br size x ~1.4 headroom for chunks
whose measured x1.4 exceeds the per-extension default; every other chunk
(current and future) is covered by the defaults. total_transfer_bytes =
sum of served bytes (.br when present, raw otherwise) x ~1.25.
Chunks below raw_threshold_bytes legitimately have no .br sibling
(vite.config.ts compression threshold: 1024) and count at raw size.

schneidet den sigma/luma-Unterbau anders. Im gepinnten Container gemessen

ergaebe: die gemessene Summe ist GESUNKEN, und eine Decke hebt man nicht,
